name: read_file
description: Reads a file from the file system.

end_line.description: The line number to end reading at (inclusive). If not provided, reads until the end of the file.

path.description: The path to the file to read.

start_line.description: The line number to start reading from (inclusive). If not provided, reads from the beginning of the file.

exclude_patterns.description: The pattern to exclude files against. '**' can be used to match any number of directories, '*' can be used to match any number of characters in a file or directory name.

max_files.description: The maximum number of files to return.

pattern.description: The pattern to match files against. '**' can be used to match any number of directories, '*' can be used to match any number of characters in a file or directory name.

root_dir.description: The root directory to start the search from.

name: git_diff
description: Returns the diff of a files with a range of commits.

commit_id.description: The commit ID to diff against. If type is 'single_commit', this is the commit ID. If type is 'commit_range', this is ignored. If type is 'branch', this is ignored and defaults to the current HEAD.

files.description: The files to diff. If not provided, diffs all files.

from.description: The branch or commit range to diff. If type is 'branch', this is the branch name. If type is 'commit_range', this is the format 'from..to'. If type is 'single_commit', this field is ignored.

to.description: The branch or commit to diff against. If type is 'branch', this is ignored and defaults to the current HEAD. If type is 'commit_range', this is the format 'from..to'. If type is 'single_commit', this field is ignored.

type.description: The type of the diff range.

name: git_diff_summary
description: Returns the summary of a diff of a files with a range of commits.

commit_id.description: The commit ID to diff against. If type is 'single_commit', this is the commit ID. If type is 'commit_range', this is ignored. If type is 'branch', this is ignored and defaults to the current HEAD.

files.description: The files to diff. If not provided, diffs all files.

from.description: The branch or commit range to diff. If type is 'branch', this is the branch name. If type is 'commit_range', this is the format 'from..to'. If type is 'single_commit', this field is ignored.

to.description: The branch or commit to diff against. If type is 'branch', this is ignored and defaults to the current HEAD. If type is 'commit_range', this is the format 'from..to'. If type is 'single_commit', this field is ignored.

type.description: The type of the diff range.

name: explorer
description: Explore the codebase and find the most interesting files and symbols

changed_files.description: The files that have changed since the last commit.

constraints.description: The constraints to apply to the search.

max_depth.description: The maximum number of symbols to return per file.

max_files.description: The maximum number of files to return.

max_snippets_per_file.description: The maximum number of snippets to return per file.

initial_files.description: The initial files to start with.

framework.description: The framework used in the repository.

language.description: The programming language of the repository.

root_directories.description: The root directories to search within the repository.

model.description: The model to use for the review.
